content:
We just released Mastodon v4.7.3, v4.6.9, v4.5.19 and v4.4.26.

They contain many bugfixes in addition to updating some of our dependencies to fix security issues in those.

We recommend administrators to update when they can.

Full release notes and update instructions are available on the GitHub releases page.

https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/releases

#mastoadmin
